row.name: Sjb Childcare LLC DBA Growing in Graces

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: One child's file did not have emergecny medical authorization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: A self-report was not received regarding a child in care who wandered away from the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: It was found that a child in care managed to run out the front doors and into the shopping strip where the operation is located.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records: During the director's absence, a caregiver was left in charge at naptime who did not have access to all essential information and records. This was corrected when the designee and second person in command arrived at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: In the toddler room, sharp and hazardous office supplies such as hole punchers, staple remover, adult scissors, and a letter opener were found on the children shelving accessible to children.  This was corrected when these items were removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: The afterschool restroom ceiling panel is missing and found behind the toilet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The wooden fence surrounding the big playground has a wooden board that has fallen and has exposed nails accessible to children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entrapment Openings: The big slide on the big playground has an opening at the top of the slide that could potentially trap a child's hand or clothing when sliding down the equipment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entrapment Openings (26 TAC §746.4601(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children: A mop bucket with water was found in the hallway accessible to children. This was corrected when the bucket was removed from thhe hallway.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))

occurrences.finding: HRC 42.04271 - Parent's Rights: Three children's records did not have a statement or proof that the parent's received a copy of parents' rights.
occurrences.violation_type_title: HRC 42.04271 - Parent's Rights (26 TAC §HRC 42.04271 - Parent's Rights)

occurrences.finding: AP Must Place Infants in Face up Sleeping Position or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant: A 5 month infant was placed and found sleeping on their tummy who is unable to roll over independently. There is no sleep exception form for the infant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Must Place Infants in Face up Sleeping Position or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant (26 TAC §746.2427(a))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach: In the infant and toddler rooms. diaper rash creams were observed to be on top of the diaper changing table in reach of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §746.3501(6))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Poisonous/Toxic Materials Stored Separate from Food: Two bottles of cleaning chemicals were observed to be stored next to boxed of snack crackers and a jar of jelly
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Poisonous/Toxic Materials Stored Separate from Food (26 TAC §746.3317(10))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: A 6 mo old not yet on table food did not have feeding instructions completed by the parent
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: Emergency medical authorization was not available for 2 children being transported.    NOTE:Corrected at inspection, the medical authizations forms were provided during the inspection
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: One caregiver did not have the training in abuse and neglect and building and premise safety training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child: 2 children being transported did not have parent or emergecy contact information.     NOTE:Corrected at inspection,parent contact forms were provided during the inspection
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary: 3 gallons of milk dated 4/15, 4/16 and 4/16 was observed to be in the refrigerator. One of the gallon with the 4/16 exppiration date was served to children for breakfast.    NOTE: Corrected at the inspection. All expired milk was disposed of during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary (26 TAC §746.3317)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib: Two cribs in the infant room was were observed to have two mattresses in the crib.    NOTE:Corrected at inspection, the second mattresses were removed during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan: 3 children with listed diagnosed food allergies did not have an allergy plan of file and available for review,
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(16))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points: A catipliller toy on the playground was observed to be broken and had exposed shear points.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points (26 TAC §746.4601(7))

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: 3 children observed sitting in a bean shaped table with straps were not observed to be strapped in. One of the seats did not have straps.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over: A television on top of a rolling shelf was not observed to be properly anchored.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over (26 TAC §746.3701(10))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: Two vehicles used for transportation did not have have completed first aid kits.       NOTE:Corrected at inspection. Missing items were replaced during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A caregivers purse and uncovers electrical outlets were observed in the toddler room. Uncovered electrical outlets were observed in the pre-k room
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Cover All Stored Food: A 2lb roll of ground beef was observed to be open and uncovered in the freezer.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Cover All Stored Food (26 TAC §746.3317(8))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: In the toddler room on the diaper changing table disinfectant spray and hand sanitizer was observed in reach. In the pre-k room a bottle of disinfectant spray way observed in reach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: Several bottles in the infant room were observed to be unlabeled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: The fire extinguisher on one of the vans used was not observed to be secured.     NOTE: The fire extinguisher was observed to be in the box and under the passenger front seat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room: An emergency evacution diagram was not posted near all exits used.     NOTE: Corrected at inspection, diagrams were posted during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room (26 TAC §746.5207(b))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: In the bathroom of the toddler room, the ceiling was observed to missing a panel.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Not expired or damaged in accident: 5 car seats located on both vans used  were observed to be expired. Expiration years were 2016,2017,2018,2020,2022      NOTE:Corrected at inspection. All expired carseats were removed and dissposed during the inspection
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Not expired or damaged in accident (26 TAC §746.5607(b))

occurrences.finding: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials: A cleaning solution Lemon Plus was not being used according to manufacture instructions. According to the director, an unknown amount of solution is mixed with a bottle of water. The solutiion is used to sanitize table tops   According to the instrcutions, the product is not to be used on surfaces that come into contact with food.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials (26 TAC §746.3407(13))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: The child safety alarm on  one of the vehicles being used for transportation was not operational during the inspection    NOTE: The operation was informed the van may not be used until the safety alarm has been repaired
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The children product safety certificate was last completed 2/1/23
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: 3 cribs used in the infant room were observed to have loose fitted sheets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Minimum Standards (26 TAC §746.1203(1))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: Two of the bucket seats at the toddler table did not have safety straps. This was corrected at inspection when the Director removed the seats from the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans (26 TAC §746.2203(a))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitize Sleeping Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407(4))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Crib for Each Non-walking Infant Younger Than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2405(2))
